meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按约定式提交格式写提交信息:标题用“类型(范围): 祈使句摘要”,正文仅在需要时写原因、破坏性变更、迁移或关联问题。只输出可粘贴的代码块,不执行 git 命令,默认不写 AI 署名。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”或“commit message”等,或使用 /commit 等斜杠命令时触发;说“stop caveman-commit”或“normal mode”会恢复正常提交风格。

say.note: Claude 会生成一条约定式提交信息。
返回主题行,必要时带正文。
输出代码块,不执行提交。

howto.what_en: Claude writes Conventional Commits messages. Subject: type(scope)+imperative summary. Body only when needed: non-obvious why, breaking changes, migrations, linked issues. Outputs a code block; does not run git commands; no AI attribution by default.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a commit" or "commit message", or use slash commands such as /commit. Saying "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" restores the verbose commit style.

say_en.note: Claude will generate a Conventional Commits message.
Returns a subject line, with body if needed.
Outputs a code block; nothing is committed.
